'''Karrel Engineering''' was a company that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Heroes of Cularin]] prevented a large [[Comet/Legends|comet]] from crashing into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], Karrel Engineering gave them two high-quality tool kits as a way of thanking them.
